integrity: The general theorem is supplied with a detailed parameter-count proof and an independently implemented direct finite-field enumeration, including all exceptional events. The finite checks do not substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The finite-field count concerns unordered cyclic six-vertex conic hexagons with multiplicity, not distinct outputs of one chosen sextuple, and is restricted to smooth conics in finite characteristic-two fields of order at least eight. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: The characteristic-two Pascal-line fiber formula and complete rational-line coverage
